Join our discord

About the demo
The demo will show you how the game will be. It's single-player now, but in the future will be online co-op horror.
When The Full Game Will Release? 
For now I don't know when the full game will finish, because the game will take more than two month to finish the beta version. 

At the end I want to thank you guys for supporting my game, I've received a very motivated messages and i'm happy with that.

Thank you for reading this announcement.
